source_items.note: Closing notes is not dispatched by the selected runtime route. Source review cannot establish an actual callback, native activation, interval, or closed-state rendering after this transition. Inspect the actual event construction, current requestID binding, guard, state transition, and exactly-once callback site; record source file and line.

source_items.clause: Source-only: changing an unsent delegate selection back to self sets the self selection, hides acknowledgment, makes confirmation valid, and emits exactly one collector:<current requestID>:self event.
source_items.note: The route starts with self selected but never activates self after choosing delegate. Initial/reset self facts do not prove the self-choice callback branch. Inspect the actual event construction, current requestID binding, guard, state transition, and exactly-once callback site; record source file and line.

source_items.clause: Source-only: a real true-to-false acknowledgment toggle emits exactly one ack:<current requestID>:false event and makes unsubmitted delegate confirmation invalid.
source_items.note: Only false-to-true acknowledgment is dispatched. Its callback and initial false value do not prove true-to-false activation or its callback interval. Inspect the actual event construction, current requestID binding, guard, state transition, and exactly-once callback site; record source file and line.

source_items.clause: Source-only: an enabled self-collection confirmation emits exactly one submit:<current requestID>:self event and applies the original submitted-state behavior.
source_items.note: Runtime confirmation is exercised only for delegate. Self primary-enabled facts do not prove an actual self submission callback or its resulting rendering. Inspect the actual event construction, current requestID binding, guard, state transition, and exactly-once callback site; record source file and line.

source_items.clause: Source-only: reselecting the already selected collector leaves selection unchanged and emits no collector event, consistent with the original different-collector requirement.
source_items.note: No same-choice activation is dispatched; an empty callback interval is not inferred from the selected route. Inspect the actual event construction, current requestID binding, guard, state transition, and exactly-once callback site; record source file and line.

source_items.clause: Source-only: disabled choice, acknowledgment and confirmation controls cannot invoke their business callbacks; guards preserve the original submitted and invalid-state behavior.
